components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but must be unique across owners when supplied.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255

## Summary

I implemented the sequential membership number for newly created owners, exposed as the integer field `membershipNumber` in the owner response.

**How the value is assigned:** a new pipeline step counts the existing owners (`ownerRepository.findAll().size()`) and sets `membershipNumber = count + 1` on the owner before it is saved (the owner isn't persisted yet, so it isn't counted). Because the acceptance test runs both creations in one rolled-back transaction, the JPQL count auto-flushes the first insert, so the second owner sees one more existing owner — giving the exact `a + 1 == b` invariant the test asserts.

**Changes:**
- `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — added the read-only `membershipNumber` (integer, int32) property to the `Owner` schema; the OpenAPI codegen regenerates `OwnerDto` with the field, and MapStruct maps it by name automatically.
- `model/Owner.java` — added the persisted `membershipNumber` field (`membership_number` column) with getter/setter.
- `rest/function/owner/AssignMembershipNumber.java` — new OfficeFloor function that reads the `@Val Owner`, counts owners, and sets the membership number in place.
- `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — inserted the `assignMembership` step (governed by `transaction`) between `rejectDuplicateEmail` and `save`.
- `db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql` — added the nullable `membership_number` column to the `owners` table (tests run on hsqldb; existing seed owners keep it null since the rule only applies to newly created owners).

The value is persisted, so it is returned both on the `POST` create response and on subsequent `GET /api/owners/{id}` reads.
